task.problem:
Let X be connected and compact, dd^c=(i/(2 pi))partial barpartial, and fix a smooth positive probability volume dV. All potentials are genuine canonical quasi-psh representatives, with pole values included. A smooth real (1,1) background theta is big if theta+dd^c rho>=epsilon h for a genuine potential rho, a Hermitian h and epsilon>0; it need not be closed. Ordinary order u preceq v means u<=v+C, and equivalence is mutual order. I(tu) uses |g|^2 exp(-tu), with no extra factor 2; ideal equivalence means equality at every real t>0. P_(theta,F)[u] is the usc supremum of theta-psh v<=F with v preceq u; P_(theta,F)[u]_I uses ideal-equivalent competitors. The zero-obstacle operations are P_theta[u] and P_theta[u]_I. An ordinary model is a normalized fixed point p=P_theta[p], and an ideal model also satisfies p=P_theta[p]_I. Extended products are non-pluripolar products with smooth-background corrections. Lower and upper singularity volumes are the infimum and supremum of extended mass over the entire fixed ordinary type, not the raw mass of one representative. BMP means finite supremum v_+(h) over all bounded h-psh potentials, and positive lower mass means the corresponding infimum v_-(h)>0; these are separate properties. Original S06 asks for type-sensitive regularity and stability criteria for equations in arbitrary prescribed ordinary or relative envelope types on smooth big possibly nonclosed backgrounds, beyond resolved logarithmic and exceptional minimal cases. At density zeros, find conditions on density and residual geometry yielding a smooth or Holder residual, and distinguish regularity on the complement from extension across the singular set. The relative envelope class E_env(X,theta,phi) consists of u preceq phi such that for every t>=1 some theta-psh a satisfies t^(-1)a+(1-t^(-1))phi<=u. Envelope equality is not its unrestricted definition. Also address singular envelopes and weighted extremals outside the known uniform density-in-capacity regimes. For a compact non-pluripolar K, continuous obstacle w and selecting potential phi, one precise weighted ideal envelope is the usc supremum of theta-psh a ideal-more-singular than phi with a<=w quasi-everywhere on K. Ideal order means I(ta) subset I(t phi) for every t>0. Declare any different ordinary or weighted version explicitly. Known background: local continuity above a locally bounded strict barrier, local Holder control for minimal Lp solutions, and smoothness on the full regular locus of an analytic strict barrier with smooth positive density are established under their precise hypotheses. Resolved logarithmic positive residuals and specified exceptional minimal types have quantified Holder remainders. Smooth positive global volume forms give ample-locus smoothness in every closed big Kahler class. Smooth density only on a smaller open set can accompany a discontinuous bounded solution. Smooth density zeros and their necessary exceptional vanishing order alone do not imply a smooth Hessian; explicit compact power-blowup and Pogorelov cases are already known. Finite ramification pullback and nonclosed Hopf examples already describe specified smooth zeros and residuals. A smooth positive dual maximizer already forces a smooth exact threshold equation, even at zeros. None of these settles arbitrary prescribed types or all singular extremals. No new regularity criterion, type, geometry or proof is supplied.

Independent unproved statement-only targets:

# Proposed S06 statement-only radial residual targets

These are proposed claims to prove, not imported theorems. No original
argument, paper, private calculation, reviewer report or proof method is
supplied. Retain the original task's definitions and limited scope.

A. Let k>=2, normalize Fubini--Study kappa on P^k by integral kappa^k=1,
and use dd^c=i partial barpartial/(2pi). On the chart z0=1 put r=sum|zj|^2
and u_alpha=1-[1-log(r/(1+r))]^alpha, 0<alpha<1, with its canonical value
minus infinity at o=[1:0:...:0]. The potential is genuine kappa-psh,
smooth elsewhere including the hyperplane z0=0, where it is zero. Its
extended measure q_alpha kappa^k has mass1 and smooth positive density
away from o. It is L1 and no Lp, p>1. Different alpha give different
ordinary types, although every multiplier ideal I(t u_alpha), t>0,
is trivial. No ordinary-model assertion is proposed.

B. Let q>=0 be radial, smooth on P^k minus o, including its entire
hyperplane at infinity, and have integral q kappa^k=1. Suppose
|q/q_alpha-1|<=A r^delta near o, with A,delta>0. There exists an actual
canonical radial kappa-psh U with its sole pole o, smooth elsewhere,
normalized to zero on the hyperplane, satisfying MA_kappa(U)=q kappa^k
and U ordinary equivalent to u_alpha. It belongs to the exact relative
stretching class E_env(P^k,kappa,u_alpha), canonically at the common pole.
In the radial family of such smooth-off-pole solutions with zero central
radial flux and no hyperplane singularity it is unique up to constants.
No nonsymmetric uniqueness or zero-obstacle envelope identity is claimed.

C. Its actual residual R=U-u_alpha off o extends with a finite limit R0.
For L=1-log r, there is a finite C with
|R-R0|<=C r^delta L^(alpha-2),
|R'|<=C r^(delta-1) L^(alpha-2),
|R''|<=C r^(delta-2) L^(alpha-2).
It is locally Holder with exponent min(1,2delta). For delta>=1/2 it
extends C1 with zero gradient at o; for delta>=1 it extends C2 with zero
Hessian there, including both critical endpoints. No derivative bound
on the density error is needed for these assertions. U(o) remains minus
infinity; only the genuine pole-subtracted residual crosses the pole.

D. Under B, if g=q/q_alpha-1 satisfies (r d/dr)^j g=O(r^N) for every
N,j>=0, then R-R0 extends smoothly with every derivative zero at o.
Mere determinant decay or density smoothness off o is not this condition.

E. Choose nonnegative smooth radial cutoffs chi0=1 near o with small
finite support, and a nonzero chi1 in a disjoint finite annulus. Set
B0=(integral r^delta chi0 q_alpha kappa^k)/(integral chi1 q_alpha kappa^k)
and q_c=q_alpha[1+c(r^delta chi0-B0 chi1)]. For sufficiently small c>0,
these are genuine compact positive probability data smooth off o and at
infinity, in no Lp,p>1. The B solution has
R_c(r)-R_c(0) asymptotic to [c alpha(1-alpha)/delta^2]r^delta L^(alpha-2),
R_c'(r) asymptotic to [c alpha(1-alpha)/delta]r^(delta-1)L^(alpha-2).
For delta<1/2 its gradient is unbounded; for delta<1 its Hessian is
unbounded. For 2delta<1 it has no larger Holder exponent. Thus the C1/C2
thresholds cannot be lowered. Replacing r^delta chi0 by exp(-1/r)chi0 and
adjusting B0 by the same integral produces a nonzero perturbation with a
smoothly flat residual, an actual example of D.

F. Conditional on a connected compact Hermitian m-fold (X0,h0) having
v_minus(h0)=0, put V0=integral h0^m, N=m+k and H=h0+kappa on X0 x P^k.
Then H is genuinely nonclosed and has zero lower mass. The actual
pullback solution has extended measure binomial(N,m)h0^m wedge q kappa^k,
of finite mass binomial(N,m)V0. Its ordinary type and the relative
stretching class are those of pullback u_alpha; its residual regularity
crosses X0 x {o}. No proof that a named factor exists is supplied or
imported, and no exact individual threshold is asserted in this claim.
The projective examples E supply nonvacuity for the principal criterion.

Permitted elementary foundations: local psh representatives and
decreasing limits, standard normalized Fubini--Study geometry, elementary
local radial determinant/integration, real calculus, and the bounded
corrected products and locality of BGL Section2.1. Its Section2.2 global
unbounded-product theorem requires BMP and is not granted on the
conditional nonclosed product. Independently assess each exact application
and identify all additional uncertain external premises honestly.

These are limited radial regularity conditions in prescribed ordinary
nonlogarithmic types. General nonsymmetric types, density zeros outside this radial family and
weighted extremals remain open. No priority assertion is granted.


G. Under B with nonnegative q, U and its residual are smooth across every
density zero off the canonical pole, including zeros along the hyperplane.
For every k>=2 and 0<alpha<1 there exists nonnegative radial probability
q0 smooth off o and at infinity, equal to q_alpha near o and zero on a
nonempty open finite annulus. It is in L1 and no Lp,p>1. Its actual solution
retains ordinary type u_alpha and has a globally smooth residual constant
near o. Construct and prove such compact data explicitly. Mere local
density smoothness without the stated tail and radial hypotheses is not
a granted regularity principle. Weighted extremals remain unanswered.
task.completionCriteria:
Prove new nonvacuous type-sensitive regularity or stability conditions beyond the listed cases, with a genuine prescribed class and a quantitative conclusion for an actual compact example. For density zeros, give sufficient residual hypotheses and justify any crossing of the zero or pole set. For envelopes specify the precise weighted operator and how the conditions go beyond the known density-in-capacity regime. Do not derive smoothness from local density smoothness or determinant vanishing order alone, conflate a potential with its pole-subtracted residual, or apply closed minimal-type uniqueness in an arbitrary nonclosed ordinary class. Independently reconstruct the full proof and verify exact indispensable primary hypotheses; keep each answered part and remaining general scope explicit.

Independently reconstruct every limited A--G target, including its specified nonnegative radial density-zero extension, and retain all limitations. This proof object is scoped; original_S06_completed=false because the full weighted-extremal and nonsymmetric programmes are unresolved.
